message:
fix(OP-04): validate canonical bars and preserve finality in both RC6 paths

One decoder verifies schema, envelope and nested bar hashes, provenance, numeric/time invariants. Bulk validates identity/order across chunks and excludes OPEN only under CLOSED_BAR_ONLY. Revised envelopes fail closed pending snapshot-proof transport; OP-04 remains partial for revision replay.
